This project is a hobby of me, so updates are slow.
I have no intenion of making money off this project, being: no subcriptions, no fees, no donations.
This project is also open source, so you may mod the program, just don't break it.
You can make custom servers. You can change your server IP in settings.
---Developers---
MMIC's Developer: kaidun1112cubosh 😻
Intro by JloAu📱 (used code from ScratchOS 3.0 [hes the dev!], mainly because it was discontinued 😂)
I can't remember Flip Rush's dev, but I don't think I need to because its unshared, and still unshared (as of April 8th, 2026).
Monster Run was created by Peperoni_0f_Scratch 🍕
The Among Us Songs were externaly recorded, but that doesnt change the fact i have no owning right to the audio.
---Story of MMIC---
The MMIC Sound Player, on Scratch, was my first and biggest project.
I still have alfha and betas and 1.0.0 on my device.
On Scratch, the current version is 1.1.7, yet saying Discontinued now.
I discontinued it on scratch becuase I hit the sound size limit, and no matter what I did (even not sound related), I couldn't save the project, not even deleting the sounds helped.
This was around the time I had found out about PenguinMod form a YouTube video, and then Snail IDE (used to code this) from Scratch Loader GX
When I discoved the extension, CouldLink, I had the idea to make MMIC a ad-free streaming service for music and even videos, thanks to PenguinMod's extension for that
So about a year after MMICs inital release date, I'm creating version 1.1.8!🤗
---What's New---
The app is now 16:9, 60fps, and has interpolation.
I also disabled the clone limit, becuase I perfer clone text engines for qulity.
The engine has been redone, to be cloud-based, and computer-upload-based (in the case you have no internet).
You can upload your own audio files and a .m3u8 and (as long as all files are there) play offline music.
It will use device storage.
Settings for MMIC are also stored on your device.

You will have a import/export account feature, allowing you to get all your audio files and settings back. If you leave the zip unchanged, you can upload it to another computers MMIC cleint and have all of your cool stuff!
I intended it to be a backup and a saver in case a audio drive gets croupted are something.🥹
---About the Dev---
I'm mainly privacy focused so I'd rather not say much about myself.
But if you want to talk, then find kaidun1112cubosh on Eaglercraft servers. (Hint, its the light-bule catgirl).
You can also dm me, my username is also kaidun1112cubosh
On Roblox, my display is kaidun1112, but my username is (once again) kaidun1112cubosh
If you need support, you may call (517)-331-9677 and someone will answer you and your questions.

{(.text: Clears the filesystem. All of the contents of filesystem are erased. Calling this block does NOT affect file staging.

{*.text:
If the file filename does not exist, this block will create that file with size "size." Each newly created line is filled with an empty string.
If the file does exists, it is first deleted.

{,.text: If the file exists, returns a 1. If not, returns a 0.

{..text:
Returns the index, or item number, of the first line of data in the given filename if it exists.
If the file does not exist, returns an item number that is greater than the filesystem's number of lines.

{:.text: If the file filename exists, delete the file from the filesystem.

{=.text:
If the file filename exists, and has a size of at least "line", this block will read the contents at that line are return that string.
If the filename does not exists, an empty string is returned.

{@.text:
If the file filename exists and has a size of at least "line", then this block will remove that line.
If the file does not exist, this block does nothing.

{].text: get the size of the file

{_.text: only remove a line if the referenced line actually exists.

{{.text:
Do not call this function if you are using this API.
Updates the lists filenames and file_locations.
This should be called if any file is modified, created, deleted, and the tables are to be used for some reason.

{}.text:
Bumps a file.
If the input filename exists, then the file is optimized for access.
Call this if you intend to access a file heavily in succession.

|a.text:
Appends the content to the end of the file.
If the file does not exist, do nothing.

|c.text: points to the very last line of the file

|e.text: update the size of the file

|g.text:
Takes the contents of the list named "file stage" and puts it into a file with the name from the variable "file stage name"
This is the primary way of safely transferring a file from the local computer to the scratch file system.

|k.text: If the file filename exists and has a size of at least "line", the string stored at "line" is replaced by "content."

|m.text:
Ignore this.
This is only for testing purposes

|o.text:
Copies a given file from the file system and puts it in the list file_stage. It also sets the variable "file stage name" to the provided filename.
If the file does not exist, this block clears the list file_stage and makes the variable "file stage name" empty.
This is the primary way of safely transferring files from the file system to the local computer.

|s.text:
Returns the size of the file, or the number of lines.
If the file does not exist, a -1 (negative 1) is returned.

|u.text: If possible, removes the top item off the output_stack

|w.text:
If the file source_filename exists, the file new_filename is created and the contents of source_filename are copied over to new_filename.
If the file source_filename does not exist, no action is taken.
If the file new_filename already exists, it overwrites it which means the file new_filename is erased are then copies the contents of source_filename.

y^.text:
My customizable progress bar has many features ! Here are the features :

• Start • 0 to 360 • The angle of the beginning (0 is on the top)
• Direction • 1 or -1 • The direction of rotation of the circle (1 is clockwise, -1 is counterclockwise) • The default value is 1.
• Quality • 1 to 360 •The number of segments that make up the whole circle (low value = + performance + possibility to make polygons) (24 is the default value)
• Progress • 0 to 100 • The percentage of progress (if the value is > 100 or < 0 the progress bar will not be displayed)
• Color • Tint (0 - 100) • Saturation (0 -100) • Brightness (0 -100) • The color of the cicular progress bar
• Thickness • Thickness of the circular progress bar
• Position • X • Y • Position of the center of the circle
• Radius • Radius of the circular progress bar

• Dotted? • true/false • If true the circular progress bar is made with dots
• Background? • true/false • If true a backgound will be displayed under the circular progress bar with these following settings:

• BG Color • Tint (0 - 100) • Saturation (0 -100) • Brightness (0 -100) • The color of the Background
• BG Thickness • Thickness of the Background
